Consultations.joinLede: Everything happens on this page. There is nothing to install.
Consultations.whatHappensTitle: What happens when you go in
Consultations.whatHappensArrival: {clinic} is told that you have arrived.
Consultations.whatHappensPass: A one-time pass is issued for you and nobody else. Sending this page to another person does not let them in.
Consultations.whatHappensHonest: If {clinic} has not switched on video yet, the room says so plainly instead of showing you a blank screen.
Consultations.resumeNote: If your connection drops, open this same link again. It is also how you come back in.
Consultations.notOpenTitle: This consultation is not open yet
Consultations.notOpenBody: You can go in from {opensAt}. Keep this page — the same link is the way in.
Consultations.notConfirmedTitle: This booking is not confirmed yet
Consultations.notConfirmedBody: A booking is confirmed once payment has gone through, or once {clinic} agrees that you will pay at the desk. Nothing can be joined until then.
Consultations.finishedBody: The room for this booking is closed. Anything written down during it stays in your records with {clinic}.
Consultations.closedTitle: This booking is no longer open
Consultations.closedBody: It was cancelled, missed or closed, so there is no room to go into.
Consultations.entryRefusedTitle: We could not let you in
Consultations.entryRefusedBody: {clinic} did not open the room for this booking. That usually means the consultation has finished or the booking has changed since this page was loaded.
Consultations.entrySessionBody: Sign in again with {clinic}, then open this same link once more. Nothing about your booking has changed.
Consultations.entryFailedTitle: We could not open the room
Consultations.entryFailedBody: Something went wrong on the way in. Try once more — pressing the button again is safe, and it does not use up your booking with {clinic}.
Consultations.roomTitle: You are in the consultation room
Consultations.roomLede: This room is for you and the clinician at {clinic}. Nobody else can come in.
Consultations.notStartedTitle: The clinician has not started the consultation yet
Consultations.notStartedBody: Stay on this page. It checks for you every few seconds, and you can also check it yourself.
Consultations.updatesOnItsOwn: This page checks for changes on its own.
Consultations.modeHeldTitle: This consultation is being held by {mode}
Consultations.modeHeldBody: That is how it was booked.
Consultations.modeSteppedDownBody: {mode} needs less of your connection than {booked}, so the clinician moved it. The change is written on your consultation record, so what actually happened is what is recorded.
Consultations.modeSteppedUpBody: The connection improved, so the clinician moved it back up. The change is written on your consultation record.
Consultations.endedCompleted: Anything the clinician wrote down, and any prescription, is in your records with {clinic}.
Consultations.endedConverted: {clinic} has asked to see you in person instead. Nothing can be prescribed from a consultation that ends this way.
Consultations.endedTechnicalFailure: The connection could not be restored in time, so the consultation was closed. Nothing written down was lost. Contact {clinic} to arrange another time.
Consultations.endedPatientNoShow: This was recorded as a missed appointment. Contact {clinic} if that is wrong.
Consultations.endedClinicianUnavailable: The clinician could not attend. Contact {clinic} to arrange another time.
Consultations.endedGeneric: The record of it is with {clinic}.
Consultations.mediaUnavailableTitle: Video and voice are not switched on yet
Consultations.mediaUnavailableBody: {clinic} has not finished setting up video calling, so this page carries no picture and no sound. You are genuinely in the room and your arrival is recorded — there is simply nothing to show you yet.
Consultations.mediaNoClientTitle: This page cannot open the video yet
Consultations.mediaNoClientBody: {clinic}'s video is switched on, but this version of the portal does not yet carry the part that opens the picture. Please tell {clinic} that you saw this.
Consultations.chatUnavailableTitle: Typing to the clinician is not switched on yet
Consultations.chatUnavailableBody: There is no message box here, because nothing you typed would reach the clinician. When it is switched on, messages appear here and stay in your records with {clinic} — never in a text message to your phone.
Consultations.leaveNote: Leaving does not end the consultation. Open the same link to come back in.
Consultations.emergency: Do not wait for this consultation. {clinic} asks that if someone is seriously unwell, bleeding heavily, struggling to breathe or unconscious, you go to the nearest health facility now.
Consultations.emergencyWithPhone: Do not wait for this consultation. {clinic} asks that if someone is seriously unwell, bleeding heavily, struggling to breathe or unconscious, you go to the nearest health facility now, or call {clinic} on {phone}.
